response.original_title: Duff McKagan - Lighthouse - Live From London
response.overview: Duff McKagan has spent his entire career proving that rock can have soul without losing its edge. With Lighthouse: Live From London, the bassist for Guns N’ Roses and Velvet Revolver delivers a work that encapsulates the maturity and heart of his most recent period. Recorded on October 5, 2024, at London’s Islington Assembly Hall, this album (available on CD, vinyl, Blu-ray, and digital) captures a magical night from the Lighthouse Tour ’24, where emotion and honesty reign supreme over the noise.
response.title: Duff McKagan - Lighthouse - Live From London
